data.body: Implemented and merged as Gerrit change 2827. RCA: the triage script only rendered timeout/cancelled/failed, so a checkout transport fault that exhausted the in-job retries would still read like a code/test failure. The fix adds portable observable transport markers (git RPC HTTP 5xx, fatal unable to access, TLS/connectivity/timeouts, hung-up/early EOF) and reports INFRASTRUCTURE/TRANSPORT FAULT with wording that CI could not obtain the source and is not judging the change. Genuine pytest/test failures remain FAILED. RED was tests/scripts/test_summarize_ci_failures.py showing a captured Gerrit checkout 504/RPC annotation classified as FAILED; GREEN targeted tests passed; full make verify passed with GIT_CONFIG_* unset; Gerrit 2827 passed LLM-Review+1 and Verified+1 and was submitted.
